Follow-up to [v1.1.31](https://github.com/dyonng/one-pace-plex-automator/releases/tag/v1.1.31),
fixing the aftermath of a qBittorrent outage rather than the outage itself.

## Retrying an episode failed with "status code 409"

When an import errors partway through, the torrent stays in qBittorrent because
the cleanup step never runs. Retrying the episode then tried to **add a torrent
qBittorrent already held**, which it refuses — so every retried episode failed to
dispatch and dropped back to `pending`, where it would attempt the same doomed
add on every cycle indefinitely.

The irony is that nothing needed downloading: those torrents were sitting there
complete the whole time.

Dispatch now reattaches to the existing torrent instead of re-adding it, so the
next completion sweep imports it without transferring a byte. Independently,
`addMagnet` treats a refused add as success once it confirms the torrent is
actually present, so the same conflict can't strand an episode from any other
call path.

## qBittorrent errors now say what qBittorrent said

Axios reports only `Request failed with status code N`, discarding the one-line
reason qBittorrent puts in the response body — which is what made the above need
a code read to diagnose. That reason is now part of the logged message, for
failed logins as well as failed API calls.

## Upgrading

Pull the image and restart. The startup cycle reattaches anything stranded in
`pending` and imports it on the following sweep — no buttons to press.
